plan.title: Project Setup, Architecture & Recommendation Domain Schemas
plan.description: Scaffold repository structure, core models for products, users, interactions, ratings, purchase transactions, and automated test framework.

plan.title: Product Catalog Repository & Multidimensional Tagging Store
plan.description: Implement in-memory and persistent product catalog with category taxonomy, brand metadata, pricing attributes, and keyword indexing.

plan.title: User Preference Profiler & Explicit Interest Matrix
plan.description: Build user interest profiler capturing explicit category preferences, brand affinities, price range filters, and preference decay factors.

plan.title: Purchase History Analyzer & Transaction Ledger Ingestion
plan.description: Ingest transaction logs, compute repeat purchase frequency, customer lifetime value (CLV), recency-frequency-monetary (RFM) segmentation, and basket history.

plan.title: Sparse Interaction Matrix Builder & Rating Normalizer
plan.description: Construct sparse User-Item interaction matrix, support implicit-to-explicit rating conversions, and implement mean-centering normalization.

plan.title: User-Based Collaborative Filtering (User-User Cosine & Pearson)
plan.description: Calculate pairwise user similarity using Cosine similarity and Pearson correlation, find top-k nearest neighbors, and predict missing product ratings.

plan.title: Item-Based Collaborative Filtering (Item-Item Adjusted Cosine)
plan.description: Compute item-to-item similarity matrix with adjusted cosine distance to recommend products similar to past purchases.

plan.title: Matrix Factorization & Latent Factor Decomposition (SVD / ALS)
plan.description: Implement matrix decomposition to discover latent user preferences and product features, minimizing prediction error with regularized learning.

plan.title: Content-Based Filtering & Product Feature Vector Extraction
plan.description: Generate product TF-IDF and categorical feature vectors, matching candidate products against a user's cumulative taste profile.

plan.title: Hybrid Recommendation Blending Engine (Weighted Multi-Model Ensemble)
plan.description: Merge collaborative filtering predictions with content-based scores via an adaptive weighted rank fusion algorithm.

plan.title: Cold-Start Onboarding Strategy & Popularity Fallback Engine
plan.description: Solve cold-start for new users and fresh products using onboarding preference questionnaires, category trending items, and Bayesian average popularity.

plan.title: Real-Time Session-Based Recommender & Short-Term Intent Tracker
plan.description: Track immediate in-session browsing signals, recency decay, and short-term intent to update recommendations in real-time.

plan.title: Implicit Feedback Processor (Clicks, Views, Cart Additions & Dwell Time)
plan.description: Translate behavioral micro-signals (views, scroll depth, cart adds, wishlists) into calibrated confidence-weighted interaction scores.

plan.title: Dynamic Re-Ranking, Novelty Boost & Filter-Bubble Mitigator
plan.description: Implement diversity-aware re-ranking (Maximal Marginal Relevance - MMR) to prevent recommendation echo chambers and promote novelty.

plan.title: Context-Aware Recommendations (Temporal, Seasonal & Device Context)
plan.description: Incorporate contextual dimensions such as time-of-day, day-of-week, holiday seasonality, and mobile vs. desktop purchasing habits.

plan.title: Market Basket Analysis & Frequently Bought Together (Apriori Engine)
plan.description: Mine association rules (Support, Confidence, Lift) across historical transactions to power cross-sell and 'Frequently Bought Together' bundles.

plan.title: Personalized Promotion Affinity & Price Sensitivity Matcher
plan.description: Estimate individual user price elasticity and match discounted or clearance items to price-sensitive shopper segments.

plan.title: Recommendation Evaluation Suite (Precision@K, Recall@K, MAP & NDCG)
plan.description: Implement offline evaluation metrics: Precision@K, Recall@K, Mean Average Precision (MAP), Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG), and RMSE.

plan.title: Explainable AI Recommendation Layer ('Why Recommended for You')
plan.description: Generate human-readable rationales explaining why items were suggested (e.g. 'Because you purchased Product X' or 'Top-rated in Category Y').

plan.title: A/B Testing Framework & Multi-Armed Bandit Exploration Engine
plan.description: Deploy Epsilon-Greedy and Thompson Sampling bandit algorithms to balance exploitation of proven recommendations with exploration of new items.

plan.title: User Negative Signal & Dislike Feedback Loop Processor
plan.description: Process negative feedback (dismissed recommendations, product returns, 'don't show again') to suppress inappropriate suggestions.

plan.title: High-Speed Vector Similarity Search & Index Optimization
plan.description: Implement fast approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search indices and candidate retrieval for sub-50ms recommendation generation.

plan.title: REST API Routing Layer (/recommendations/user, /similar, /preferences)
plan.description: Design modular Express/HTTP REST API endpoints serving personalized feeds, similar items, trending collections, and user preference updates.

plan.title: Interactive Web UI: Personalized Storefront & Dynamic Product Shelves
plan.description: Build responsive e-commerce web storefront featuring carousel shelves for 'Recommended for You', 'Trending Now', and 'Buy Again'.

plan.title: Interactive Web UI: User Preference Center & Purchase History Timeline
plan.description: Create user dashboard to view past orders, toggle explicit category/brand preferences, and manage personalized recommendation settings.

plan.title: Interactive Web UI: Collaborative Filtering Live Visualizer & Similarity Graph
plan.description: Interactive visualizer illustrating how user-user and item-item similarity clusters form and trigger personalized suggestions.

plan.title: Admin Analytics Dashboard: Click-Through Rates, Conversion Lift & Algorithm Benchmarks
plan.description: Executive metrics panel tracking recommendation click-through rates (CTR), conversion lift, algorithm performance, and revenue attribution.

plan.title: End-to-End Recommendation Pipeline Integration & Stress Testing
plan.description: Full end-to-end integration test suite simulating thousands of users, multi-category catalogs, concurrent recommendation queries, and stress tests.

plan.title: Data Privacy Compliance, Anonymization & High-Throughput Cache Layer
plan.description: Implement user data anonymization, GDPR right-to-be-forgotten deletion workflows, and high-performance in-memory caching.

plan.title: Production Packaging, Comprehensive User Guide & v1.0.0 Release
plan.description: Bundle production CLI executable, API documentation, end-user tutorials, benchmark reports, and official v1.0.0 release tag.
